en: Romans 12

p.src: 1  Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.

en: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.
u.src: 1  Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.

p.src: 2  Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.

en: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.
u.src: 2  Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.

p.src: 3  For I say through the grace that was given me, to everyone who is among you, not to think of yourself more highly than you ought to think; but to think reasonably, as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith.

en: For I say through the grace that was given me, to everyone who is among you, not to think of yourself more highly than you ought to think; but to think reasonably, as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith.
u.src: 3  For I say through the grace that was given me, to everyone who is among you, not to think of yourself more highly than you ought to think; but to think reasonably, as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith.

p.src: 4  For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don’t have the same function,

en: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don’t have the same function,
u.src: 4  For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don’t have the same function,

p.src: 5  so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually members of one another,

en: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually members of one another,
u.src: 5  so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually members of one another,

p.src: 6  having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us: if prophecy, let’s prophesy according to the proportion of our faith;

en: having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us: if prophecy, let’s prophesy according to the proportion of our faith;
u.src: 6  having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us: if prophecy, let’s prophesy according to the proportion of our faith;

p.src: 7  or service, let’s give ourselves to service; or he who teaches, to his teaching;

en: or service, let’s give ourselves to service; or he who teaches, to his teaching;
u.src: 7  or service, let’s give ourselves to service; or he who teaches, to his teaching;

p.src: 8  or he who exhorts, to his exhorting; he who gives, let him do it with generosity; he who rules, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.

en: or he who exhorts, to his exhorting; he who gives, let him do it with generosity; he who rules, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.
u.src: 8  or he who exhorts, to his exhorting; he who gives, let him do it with generosity; he who rules, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.

p.src: 9  Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.

en: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.
u.src: 9  Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.

p.src: 10  In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor prefer one another,

en: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor prefer one another,
u.src: 10  In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor prefer one another,

p.src: 11  not lagging in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord,

en: not lagging in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord,
u.src: 11  not lagging in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord,

p.src: 12  rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer,

en: rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer,
u.src: 12  rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer,

p.src: 13  contributing to the needs of the saints, and given to hospitality.

en: contributing to the needs of the saints, and given to hospitality.
u.src: 13  contributing to the needs of the saints, and given to hospitality.

p.src: 14  Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse.

en: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse.
u.src: 14  Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse.

p.src: 15  Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.

en: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.
u.src: 15  Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.

p.src: 16  Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.

en: Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.
u.src: 16  Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.

p.src: 17  Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.

en: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.
u.src: 17  Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.

p.src: 18  If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.

en: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.
u.src: 18  If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.

p.src: 19  Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.”

en: Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.”
u.src: 19  Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.”

en: 12:19 Deuteronomy 32:35

p.src: 20  Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.”

en: Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.”
u.src: 20  Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.”

p.src: 21  Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

en: Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
u.src: 21  Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
